key: ["Alexander turns back from the Punjab, and within a generation a new power rises on the Ganga. Chandragupta Maurya takes Magadha and the north-west, and builds the first state to span most of the subcontinent. It has no surveyed border. It is a web of roads, garrisons and tribute. And his grandson Ashoka leaves the oldest writing in India that can be read and dated, cut into rock, in the emperor's own voice.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
